# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

**VINE ENERGY HOLDINGS LLC - CREDIT AGREEMENT AMENDMENT**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** September 14, 2021

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Vine Energy Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company operating in the oil and gas sector with hydrocarbon production and hedging activities.

**Transaction Description:** First Amendment to an existing Credit Agreement originally dated March 8, 2021. The transaction involves extending certain compliance deadlines and modifying covenant requirements. Key counterparties include Citibank N.A. as Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent, with a syndicate of lenders including Bank of America, Barclays Bank PLC, Credit Suisse AG, KeyBank National Association, Morgan Stanley Bank N.A., MUFG Union Bank N.A., Royal Bank of Canada, and Goldman Sachs Lending Partners LLC.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment provides operational flexibility by: (i) postponing the Fall 2021 Scheduled Redetermination from October 1, 2021 to December 1, 2021, and (ii) temporarily suspending hedge agreement requirements for the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2023 until December 11, 2021.

**Company Background and Context:** Vine Energy Holdings LLC is subject to a pending merger transaction with Chesapeake Energy Corporation under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated August 10, 2021. The company operates under borrowing base redetermination provisions and is required to maintain hydrocarbon hedge agreements as part of its credit facility covenant structure.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• Strong syndicate composition including major financial institutions (Citi, Bank of America, Barclays, Credit Suisse)
• Borrower maintains compliance with all existing covenants - no defaults or events of default reported
• Structured borrowing base facility with regular redetermination process providing asset-based lending security
• Pending strategic transaction with Chesapeake Energy Corporation may provide enhanced credit profile
• Administrative Agent oversight through Citibank N.A. providing institutional monitoring

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• **Merger Execution Risk:** Transaction dependent on successful completion of Chesapeake merger; mitigated by amendment providing flexibility for both completion and termination scenarios
• **Commodity Price Exposure:** Temporary suspension of hedging requirements increases price volatility exposure; mitigated by limited time period (until December 11, 2021) and existing hedge portfolio
• **Borrowing Base Risk:** Postponement of redetermination could delay potential borrowing base adjustments; mitigated by asset-based lending structure and reserve reporting requirements
• **Regulatory/Legal Risk:** Amendment subject to New York State law with standard bankruptcy/insolvency considerations
